VIGIL has THREE UI planes on main: the loopback/private operator console (ui/server.py), a keyless/cookieless PUBLIC marketing+legal plane (pubui.py serving public_site/, VIGIL_PUBLIC_PORT), and a cookie-bearing CUSTOMER edge (custui.py, VIGIL_CUSTOMER_PORT) that relays to the owner-key Provisioner. Working tree is on branch meridian-s5-expansion; the presentation+signup+billing surface (public_site, customer_app, provision.py, billing.py, pubui/custui) is on main (consumer-prA merged); onboarding_store/scim/shard_on_signup/billing-reversal remain branch-only in-flight.

The ENFORCEMENT spine the build must WIRE to already exists and is strong: an append-only, hash-chained, owner-signed, witness-anchored spine with a fail-closed KINDS write gate and domain-separated signatures; the signup transaction (_signup_commit) already appends an owner-signed, fail-closed, idempotent audit under a txn lock; and three reusable electronic-acceptance patterns exist (provision._audit authorization_affirmed inline affirmation; target_authorization.py owner-signed EngagementAuthority; login_challenges single-use PoP). So legal consent is a NEW signed record appended through EXISTING machinery, not a new trust primitive.

The TRUE gaps are: the legal.acceptance signal itself (doc/version/language/actor/org/ts/text-ref), a durable content-addressed archive of exact superseded policy text, the signup ToS/AUP affirmative-unchecked capture + fail-closed gate, the ~10 missing policy pages, a separate optional marketing opt-in, federated/SCIM org-level consent, and self-service retrieval/re-consent UI. All are additive and belong behind a new default-OFF VIGIL_* flag (matching customer_checkout_enabled / customer_oidc_enabled), byte-identical when off.

Constraints honored in the plan: do NOT weaken the gate chain, FACT-minting authority (AI advisory/demote-only), signing/integrity, tenant isolation, or RBAC default-deny; the consent record is owner-signed like every other governance mutation (a non-owner principal never produces a signature); the onboarding tour flag is NOT consent. Policy TEXT is owner/counsel input (counsel_review.py ship-gate already enforces no-unreviewed/placeholder shipping) and must be marked owner_input_needed, never fabricated. All paths are under /home/kali/vigil (READ-ONLY audit; nothing was modified).

The pattern is settings.py set_config -> _validate_config_typed (closed typed allowlist) -> _persist_env (atomic 0600 sigil.env) -> _record_signed_event (Ed25519 hash-chained spine append, returns recorded_seq); writes go through the single owner-signed funnel UI settingsAct -> POST SOV('/api/action') -> do_action, which runs RBAC (PERMISSION_BY_ACTION over vigil_core.rbac role_can, default-deny) BEFORE the server owner key signs. The browser/AI only ever send a REQUEST.

WHERE THE 7 TABS SLOT IN: as in-screen tabs INSIDE the existing single 'settings' screen (renderSettings, app.js:4569), using the established S.tab + ?tab= + hashQuery() pattern that findings (P3_TABS, app.js:3847) and brain (app.js:7140) already use. current() strips the query string, so the screen id stays 'settings' and the NAV==route()==screens.yaml 3-list contract (tools/system-map/generate.py) is UNCHANGED -- no new top-level ids for the tabs. Per-tab visibility = V.can(perm); the server still re-checks every action verb. Tabs that need a higher tier (billing/legal/entity -> owner) just map their verbs to manage_users/secrets.

CONVENTIONS A BUILDER MUST FOLLOW (exact): (1) Route registration -- UI uses if(id==='...') in route(); the sovereign backend uses path== in _do_GET/_do_POST (apps/sigil/sigil/ui/server.py). For the tabs themselves register NO new routes/ids (use ?tab=). (2) Any new write verb -> add to the closed ACTIONS frozenset (actions.py:41) + PERMISSION_BY_ACTION (accounts.py:96) + implement in do_action. (3) ui-wiring matrix regen MANDATORY: VIGIL_UIWIRING_REGEN=1 python -m pytest integration/tests/test_ui_wiring_matrix.py -- every new UI SOV/OFF path + every /api/action verb must resolve to a registered route (else DEAD BUTTON), every new read route must be UI-consumed or added to INTENTIONALLY_HEADLESS (else ORPHAN); console-side read routes also face the W17-14 orphan guard. (4) Default-OFF VIGIL_* flag gating ROUTE REGISTRATION (oidc_enabled() model, server.py:421): off => route unknown => 404, byte-identical build, tab hidden. (5) RBAC map: NAV owner:true + perm:, per-tab V.can, server default-deny. (6) CSP/no-build: V.h only, handlers as props, V.getJSON/postJSON only, then run packages/vigil-ui/sync.sh (byte-identical vendoring into both planes).

PRESERVE, NEVER WEAKEN: the conjunctive gate chain, FACT-minting authority (AI advisory/demote-only -- settings never gives the AI a write hop), signing/spine integrity (fingerprint-only for secrets), tenant isolation (new stores keyed by tenant_id like accounts/spine), RBAC default-deny. Everything new is additive + default-OFF.

GENUINELY NEW WORK is small and bounded: the tab shell UI, an org-profile.json store + one signed verb for spec 1A General, and a versioned policy-archive/acceptance store -- all other acceptance rules (gate chain, kill-switch, egress, idempotent billing, cancel/auto-topup, AI-cannot-approve) already have real enforcement to wire to, and billing/SSO/wallet belong to in-flight G/H/J2 and must not be rebuilt here.

plan.rationale: The Legal/Compliance/Billing/Authorization/Governance program is ~80% an ENFORCEMENT-COMPLETE wire job plus a bounded set of additive, flag-gated extensions. The gate chain (vigil_core/gate.py conjunctive_decide, gateway scope_match/denylist, egress_guard), the signed authority system (ui/target_authorization.py, vigil_core/authority.py, launch_gate._has_verified_authority), the kill-switch (governor/killswitch.py), the demote-only AI firewall (veracity/firewall.py) + SIGIL owner-Ed25519 governor (promotion.py/budget.py/capability.py, offense_approvals.py A3, ceremonies.py m-of-n), and the idempotent billing core (billing_spool sha256+event_id dedup, BillingSigner catalog-anchored mint, GrantMeter, wallet/metering/invoices/billing_reversal, auto_topup OFF-default, prG plan_change cancel_at_period_end) ALREADY enforce the 8 backend rules. Nothing here rebuilds them; every slice EXTENDS a named store additively, default-OFF behind a VIGIL_* flag, byte-identical when off, and preserves AI-advisory/demote-only + owner-signed mint + tenant isolation + RBAC default-deny. Ordering: the five non-overlapping domains that touch no in-flight billing/identity merge come first (settings shell -> privacy/cookie center -> data-rights -> legal archive -> AI/HITL disclosure), each depending only on the settings shell S1 and mirroring the proven onboarding_store / InvoiceRegistry patterns. The seven billing/authorization/seat slices are scheduled after the consumer wave because they collide with prG-billing, prJ2-wallet, prH-sso, W-series, A1 and stripe-default; they share a single additive invoice_row schema bump (S6->S7) and route all new money exclusively through BillingSigner + the spool. The honest boundary holds throughout: the build ships policy CAPTURE + immutable versioned ARCHIVE + ENFORCEMENT + page scaffolding; the authoritative legal TEXT, SIGIL SARL registration, tax config, real catalog prices, and the promo/seat decisions are owner/counsel input, never fabricated.
